name: contextrail-continue
description: Optional companion to ContextRail: after it saves the final handoff, asks whether to start a new session from it, and clears and continues on yes. Checkpoint handoffs before that get no question. In Lightning Mode it starts the new session after a 10-second countdown.

after_manual.title: Ask after /contextrail:handoff too
after_manual.description: Also offer a new session after a handoff you asked for, not only after ContextRail's own request.
